checkedAlternates.risk: A circlip is a flat metal ring like a washer.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A circlip snaps into a machined shaft or bore groove to retain parts axially (group-1), unlike washers placed under bolt heads/nuts (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Nyloc Lock Nut shares Lock with Split Lock Washer.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Nyloc is an internally threaded nut (group-3), not an unthreaded washer (group-2).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
